incompleteScope.notCovered: Complete stair bottom landing, opposite stair boundary, surrounding road network and southwest building/tower footprints are not validated by these two outputs. Prepared guide/coordinate files do not count as native coverage.

roadAndBuildingRisks.location: r10_c05 lower-right wooden-deck lip and stone treads, continuing into r11_c05 first row
roadAndBuildingRisks.observed: Broad painted stairs visibly meet the wooden arena edge. Step riser shading and the platform edge do not establish a navigation connection.
needsVerification: Classify stair run and top landing as a connected intended walkable route in the authoritative walkable mask.
Place actual character footprints at deck-to-stair transition and along both movement directions after scale is fixed.
Keep step shadow lines and ordinary tread joins out of obstacle masks unless a physical step barrier is intended.
roadAndBuildingRisks.currentBlockingConclusion: unknown; no mask or character test supplied

roadAndBuildingRisks.location: right and lower cut edges of r10_c05 and r11_c05 first-row partial
roadAndBuildingRisks.observed: The stair run is clipped at the right edge and continues below the available r11 first row. The full stair width, opposite stone boundary and bottom landing-to-plaza connection are not contained in these outputs.
needsVerification: Review the complete stair polygon, both side boundaries and bottom landing on the validated layout/mask.
Test approach, departure and turning with actual character occupancy; do not infer total stair throughput from this crop.

roadAndBuildingRisks.location: left edge of the staircase in both outputs, stone side wall and rounded post in r11_c05/p01_01
roadAndBuildingRisks.observed: A raised pale stone side wall separates stairs from left paving. Its side faces, cap and post project across nearby ground in the painted camera.
needsVerification: Distinguish physical wall/post footprint from cap overhang, highlights and cast shadow in the walkable mask.
Check collision margins and character silhouette overlap when passing beside the wall/post.
Do not count top-facing cap pixels as open walking floor merely because they are bright stone.
roadAndBuildingRisks.currentBlockingConclusion: physical boundary candidate; exact footprint and clearance unknown

roadAndBuildingRisks.location: r10_c05 left-side red rail and post at arena entrance
roadAndBuildingRisks.observed: Rail bars and a substantial post border the deck. The crop does not show the complete arena enclosure or every entrance opening.
needsVerification: Block the actual rail/post footprint while preserving the intended stair opening.
Confirm the complete arena entry/exit pattern in the layout and mask; this fragment cannot establish alternative routes.
Test character occupancy at the railing end rather than using painted negative gaps as passage widths.
roadAndBuildingRisks.currentBlockingConclusion: boundary and possible local pinch point to verify; no measured width

roadAndBuildingRisks.location: r11_c05/p01_01 left-side red hanging banner, pole hardware and clipped lower-left railing
roadAndBuildingRisks.observed: The banner covers a large projected area of side paving, while the pole/base has a separate solid footprint. The banner silhouette alone does not indicate whether the ground behind it is walkable.
needsVerification: Separate pole/base collision from hanging-cloth visual occlusion.
Validate character depth sorting, readability and mouse/touch picking behind or beside the banner.
Check the actual available side passage around the base using the final footprint scale.
roadAndBuildingRisks.currentBlockingConclusion: occlusion risk visible; physical obstruction extent unknown

roadAndBuildingRisks.location: r10_c05 lower-left foliage continuing along r11_c05 upper-left boundary
roadAndBuildingRisks.observed: Leaves overlap wall-side paving and meet the stone boundary. The painted foliage edge is irregular, and no planted-bed/root footprint is provided.
needsVerification: Define vegetation collision/bed footprint separately from decorative leaf overhang and shadow.
Verify character clearance on the remaining side paving without inventing a new street-tree island.
Ensure the shared-tile walkable mask is continuous beneath permitted overhang areas.
roadAndBuildingRisks.currentBlockingConclusion: unknown; cannot classify all leaf-covered pixels as blocked or walkable

roadAndBuildingRisks.location: r10_c05 wooden deck circles, partial dark emblem, plank joins and small round gold surface feature
roadAndBuildingRisks.observed: Painted markings, plank lines and a small gold round feature are visible on the deck. Their colors/heights do not provide authoritative collision semantics.
needsVerification: Treat flat decorative markings and material shadows separately from collision.
Confirm whether the gold feature is a flat inset or an interactable/solid object before including or excluding its footprint.
roadAndBuildingRisks.currentBlockingConclusion: no physical blockage can be established from these colors alone

roadAndBuildingRisks.location: approved overview around arena, southwest tower, nearby building approaches and plaza roads
roadAndBuildingRisks.observed: The approved overview depicts surrounding roads, building steps and the separate southwest tower, but the two inspected native outputs show only an arena/stair fragment and no complete surrounding building footprint or road network.
needsVerification: Use validated building footprints and connected conservative walkable polygons to review nearby approaches and circulation.
Include building bases, steps, festival props and tree beds when reviewing narrow connections.
Defer any route-network or capacity conclusion until actual scale, character occupancy and missing area coverage are available.
roadAndBuildingRisks.currentBlockingConclusion: not assessable from current native coverage; overview is contextual evidence only

knownVisualIssues.r10: Existing internal QA reports repaired wood/stone seams; external borders still pending.
knownVisualIssues.r11: Existing P2 cold/warm stone-tone seams near internal joins and slight upper-left leaf-tone difference remain.
knownVisualIssues.distinction: Tone seams are appearance/consistency issues, not evidence of physical road blockage. Conversely visually continuous stairs do not prove walkability. No route has been passed or failed on tone alone.
knownVisualIssues.geometryObservation: No obvious new stair discontinuity was apparent in the inspected whole images; this is not a walkable-mask or occupancy result.

requiredEvidenceBeforeCapacityJudgment: Authoritative walkable mask and connected regions spanning complete routes
Confirmed artwork-to-client/world scale and actual character collision/occupancy footprint
Boundary handling for rails, stone posts, hanging banner/pole, vegetation and projection occlusion
Coverage and route testing for missing adjacent terrain and building approaches
